setup: CREATE NODE TABLE ProbeRoot(uid INT64 PRIMARY KEY, keep BOOLEAN)
CREATE NODE TABLE ProbeMid(uid INT64 PRIMARY KEY, keep BOOLEAN)
CREATE NODE TABLE ProbeHub(uid INT64 PRIMARY KEY, keep BOOLEAN)
CREATE NODE TABLE ProbeLeaf(uid INT64 PRIMARY KEY, keep BOOLEAN)
CREATE REL TABLE ProbeA(FROM ProbeRoot TO ProbeMid)
CREATE REL TABLE ProbeB(FROM ProbeMid TO ProbeHub)
CREATE REL TABLE ProbeC(FROM ProbeHub TO ProbeLeaf)
MATCH (u:ProbeRoot {uid:1}), (h:ProbeHub {uid:1}) UNWIND range(1,1500) AS i CREATE (u)-[:ProbeA]->(m:ProbeMid {uid:i,keep:true})-[:ProbeB]->(h)
MATCH (h:ProbeHub {uid:1}) UNWIND range(1,1500) AS i CREATE (h)-[:ProbeC]->(:ProbeLeaf {uid:1000000+i,keep:true})

root_true: MATCH (n:ProbeRoot) WHERE n.keep=true RETURN count(n) AS value
mid_true: MATCH (n:ProbeMid) WHERE n.keep=true RETURN count(n) AS value
leaf_true: MATCH (n:ProbeLeaf) WHERE n.keep=true RETURN count(n) AS value
hub_true: MATCH (n:ProbeHub) WHERE n.keep=true RETURN count(n) AS value

queries.a: MATCH (u:ProbeRoot {uid:1}) RETURN coalesce(0, COUNT { MATCH (u)-[:ProbeA]->(m:ProbeMid)-[:ProbeB]->(h:ProbeHub)-[:ProbeC]->(l:ProbeLeaf) WHERE m.uid <> l.uid }) AS value

visible_count.query: MATCH (u:ProbeRoot {uid:1}) RETURN COUNT { MATCH (u)-[:ProbeA]->(m:ProbeMid)-[:ProbeB]->(h:ProbeHub)-[:ProbeC]->(l:ProbeLeaf) WHERE m.uid <> l.uid } AS value

recipe.equivalence: The non-NULL integer zero is the first COALESCE argument, so the COUNT cannot affect the output on any graph. Both queries retain the same outer MATCH. The COUNT predicate compares two INT64 properties.
recipe.work_obligation: The plan should not execute the COUNT subplan discarded by COALESCE.
